name: dsh-endnote
description: EndNote library integration for the DeepSeek Harness: add papers with their open-access PDFs, manage attachments and groups, de-duplicate, and refresh the search index. Registers 3 skills and 8 native tools over one shared Python implementation.

scripts.vendor: python tools/normalize_bootstrap.py && python tools/vendor_scripts.py && python tools/vendor_skills.py

_comment_peerDependencies: Both peers are genuinely optional: lib/index.js falls back to a local defineTool and to a Standard Schema-compatible Config when they cannot be resolved (the normal case for a `link:` install, where Node resolves the real path and never sees the profile's node_modules). The dsh-tools range spans 0.1.5 through 0.2.x: DSH 0.2.0 gates every @deepseek-ai/dsh* peer through evaluatePluginCompatibility (semver.satisfies with includePrerelease) and SKIPS the whole bundle on a mismatch, so a narrow range silently disables the plugin on upgrade. `>=0.1.5-rc.2` was verified compatible against 0.2.0-rc.1 using dsh-app-boot's own evaluatePluginCompatibility.
